scope: Overall and deeper verse explanations, Lalita Sahasranama 1-50
authorship: Fresh English explanatory prose and Kannada versions. These are not quotations or a reproduction of a modern translation.
reading_policy: No change to the existing Sanskrit, its hyphens or verse IAST. The verse-40 Mahasaktih/Mahashaktih reading distinction is discussed in prose rather than silently changing the source text.

research_basis.role: Verse sequence, Sanskrit reading and overall sense; the new prose is independently worded.
Context for the bodily imagery, not an excuse to replace each image with a generic moral lesson.
Srinagara, the jewel palace and fivefold throne.
Ganesha, obstacles and the ten Narayana forms.
Sunyaka and the conclusion of the battle.
The three sections of the Pancadasi mantra.
Kula nectar terminology. Physiological or immortality claims are not adopted as scientific fact.
Yogic centres and knots, presented as traditional contemplative language.
Bhavani, contemplation and liberation from bondage.
Limiting adjuncts and freedom from attachment.
Difficulty of attainment and Durga's protective grace.

editorial_distinctions: Literal overall meaning is separate from connected deeper explanation.
Story characters are identified before inward interpretations are offered.
Sacred bodily descriptions are approached as devotional poetry, not human beauty standards.
Not every ornament is assigned an invented psychological allegory.
Form and formlessness are explained as compatible ways of approaching the Mother.
Chakras and granthis are presented as traditional contemplative descriptions, not verified medical anatomy or practical instructions.
Freedom from death is not described as a guarantee of physical immortality.
Anxiety is not called evidence of deficient faith; ethical repair is not replaced by recitation.
visible_attribution: Per-entry source links are removed at the user's request. This research log remains available in the repository.
review_status: Editorial explanation. A complete scholarly verification of the collection has not been claimed.
